description: Arkheionx feedback data model for public calibration, report quality, and external evaluation workflows.

feedback_types.purpose: A readiness finding appears too noisy or incorrectly triggered.
Arkheionx missed a readiness signal that should be considered.
Feedback on clarity, length, wording, audience fit, or next steps.
A priority, confidence, evidence, or downgrade-condition calibration request.
Sanitized results from a toy, public, or authorized repository evaluation.
Feedback about Action setup, inputs, generated artifacts, or CI behavior.

common_fields.feedback_id: Stable local ID, for example FB-SYN-001.
common_fields.source_type: synthetic_internal, public_issue, private_authorized, public_demo, or maintainer_observation.
common_fields.public_source: URL or local note. Empty when no public source exists.
common_fields.repo_type: toy, public_open_source, private_authorized, contest_prep, audit_prep, or unknown.
common_fields.arkheionx_version: Version or commit used by the reporter.
common_fields.rule_packs: List of rule packs or finding families.
common_fields.status: received, needs-reproduction, accepted-calibration, rejected-not-actionable, safety-review-required, fixed, documented, or deferred.
common_fields.safety_review_required: Boolean indicating whether disclosure/safety triage is needed.

safety_rules: Do not store secrets, private keys, mnemonics, or RPC credentials.
Do not store unpatched vulnerability details from private or unauthorized targets.
Do not store exploit steps for live targets.
Do not claim external validation, customers, or adoption without committed public evidence.
